name: Cabinet generator
description: A frameless cabinet for a CNC router: shelves, doors, Blum TANDEM or MOVENTO drawers, or both, with optional blind dados and hardware holes, cut to the measured stock thickness. Each part is a named component on a plywood material, so the cut list nests it as sheet goods. Each new cabinet goes against the last, so rows (and corners) build themselves; a row can stand on a base frame of plywood strips or lumber, with its own cut list.
author: Sawhorse
